tracks.title: Formal specification + pure kernel
tracks.summary: The 77-declaration Lean ledger, strict canonical-byte encoding, pinned Rust correspondence, and separately scoped 15-declaration Aeneas audit are merged at their exact reviewed tips. The Aeneas update makes no new refinement claim.

tracks.title: Production prover baseline
tracks.summary: Setup caching, predecessor-key binding, AIR-native issuer authorization, frozen proof parameters, and explicit proof-version boundaries are on the reference main line.

tracks.title: Batching v2 + authenticated gossip
tracks.summary: The threat model, deterministic co-funded batch, two-round gossip, durable reservations, adversarial repairs, and Lean batch semantics have reproducible receipts.

tracks.title: Reference signet readiness
tracks.summary: Cold/hot synchronization, marker discovery, fees, recovery, batching amortization, and reproducible reference builds are documented. This is preparation, not a release.

tracks.title: Clean Test USD v2 integration
tracks.summary: The v1 Signal payment, zero-confirmation child, batch, RBF, and media are archived evidence. Signal PR #12 tip 784b0122 pins merged Rust f582c118 and keeps the wallet in v2-only namespaces. Exact hosted run 31549962441 is green; Rust's fresh main run, fresh fee funding, and the live v2 run remain open. The public v2 mint anchor is still unconfirmed.

tracks.title: Release + mainnet
tracks.summary: Independent security review, release signing/distribution, upstream submission, production issuer policy, and every mainnet broadcast remain deliberately unauthorized.

tracks.title: Domain hardening
tracks.summary: Apex, www, TLS, HTTPS, and organization verification are live. DNSSEC still needs Cloudflare activation and the exact DS record published at Namecheap.
